# ColivingInBrussels

> The independent, commission-free local guide to coliving in Brussels. We compare every major coliving operator, review neighborhoods, and help expats, students, and digital nomads find a home that feels warm and welcoming. We do not take booking commissions, so our comparisons are unbiased.

Key facts:
- Location focus: Brussels, Belgium (Capital of Europe)
- Audience: expats, EU staff & interns, international students, digital nomads, young professionals (25–35)
- 12 coliving operators compared side by side
- 8 Brussels neighborhoods reviewed
- A new local guide published every day (culture, food, slang, coliving tips)
- Typical all-inclusive coliving rent: €500–€1,500/month, leases from 3–6 months (some from 1 month)

## Coliving operators we cover
- Corners — design-led premium coliving in Ixelles & Uccle: https://colivinginbrussels.com/actors/corners
- Cohabs — largest, most social operator, renovated townhouses: https://colivinginbrussels.com/actors/cohabs
- Live Colonies — purpose-built "Super-Coloc", accepts couples: https://colivinginbrussels.com/actors/livecolonies
- Colive — accessible, all-inclusive, city-wide network: https://colivinginbrussels.com/actors/colive
- Ikoab — pioneer, budget-friendly, student-friendly: https://colivinginbrussels.com/actors/ikoab
- Neybor — sustainable, design-conscious, urban farming: https://colivinginbrussels.com/actors/neybor
- Habyt — global, digital-first, flexible leases: https://colivinginbrussels.com/actors/habyt
- Morton Place — boutique luxury coliving, Châtelain: https://colivinginbrussels.com/actors/morton-place
- Sharies — fully-serviced, 100% digital, Saint-Gilles & centre: https://colivinginbrussels.com/actors/sharies
- Co-Homing — a dozen central houses, private bathrooms: https://colivinginbrussels.com/actors/co-homing
- Comoon — amenity-rich houses on the EU-quarter axis: https://colivinginbrussels.com/actors/comoon
- Coloc Housing — accessible flatshare-style coliving: https://colivinginbrussels.com/actors/coloc-housing
